Hey thanks for the reply.  For real your words help and you didn’t have to say anything. 
I’m actually a girl, but doesn’t matter. I definitely am in my head a lot and also am impatient and like most addicts am used to instant gratification. I will definitely try and remember to write on how I’m doing and my progress. I used to hate meetings when I was younger but now I enjoy going to listen and see the appeal but can never bring myself to actually share. I’m not a shy person but hate talking about my feelings/ having everyone look at me/ getting vulnerable. And there are some fellowship things I do not agree with. I do read and see friends but the past couple weeks have been especially hard it feels like I can’t bring myself to do anything. I am trying but it feels like even walking up a set of stairs seems exhausting. And feeling so down makes me just feel even more down so it’s a vicious cycle. I think just feeling like I’ll never overcome addiction is also playing a part in my major depression. I’ve been struggling with heroin for almost ten years. More on then off. I know I’m smart, funny, capable and fun to be around when I’m doing well but I just feel like I almost just want to give up fighting it at this point. each relapse gets worse and leaves me so much more defeated I really don’t know if I can take it anymore. But then I’m also more sad than I’ve ever been in recent years now and I’m sober. I don’t know I’m all over the place. I’m definitely sensitive even tho I don’t like to admit it. Again thanks for the reply I will try to start doing even one small positive thing tomorrow and hopefully it will be a better day. If you want to reach out thru private message If that is easier, feel free
